sources.title: LoRA (machine learning) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique for large language models and other deep neural networks. Introduced in 2021 by researchers at Microsoft, LoRA enables adaptation of pre-trained models to specific tasks while requiring significantly fewer computational resources and trainable parameters than traditional full model fine-tuning.
